registry_title: Portfolio evidence register (frozen recorded stage results)
metric_scope: All case outcomes are fictional/author-labeled or scripted. No independent human adjudication; no reported real-world groundedness, real-dollar cost, or production recommendation accuracy.

records.title: Frozen retrieval baseline
records.valid_interpretation: Small synthetic semantic retrieval comparison; cannot establish real-world recall

records.title: Strict Single-Agent real-Qwen benchmark
records.cohort: 15 normal + 10 red-team author-labeled synthetic requests (19 positive / 6 impossible)
records.valid_interpretation: Original strict format baseline, no independent claim-groundedness score

records.title: Offline deterministic format recovery
records.cohort: Same 19 saved real Qwen responses and six no-match synthetic cases
records.valid_interpretation: Mechanically normalizes output syntax; improves structural/relevance author-label evaluation, NOT semantic support

records.title: Real-Qwen paired deterministic Critic and revision
records.cohort: Same frozen 25 author-labeled synthetic cases; first draft shared across 0 vs 1 revision
records.valid_interpretation: One revision did not improve strict author-label success and added cost; stricter acceptance gate differs from Single-Agent

records.title: Real-Qwen output-format and evidence-preflight 2-by-2
records.cohort: Same frozen 25 requests; 19 generated first drafts, 6 hard-filter no-match; plus one separate source smoke
records.valid_interpretation: Logical 19-to-10 policy-call difference; physical generation shared across matrix, NOT nine saved billed calls

records.title: Deterministic typed-source atomic-claim audit
records.cohort: 26 author-written claim examples, 22 explicitly typed + 4 open-text deferred for review
records.valid_interpretation: Engineered author-label contract agreement, NOT general semantic accuracy; 15 original Qwen recommendation reasons exported for blind review but not annotated

records.title: Separate real 0.5B-Qwen atomic claim Critic
records.cohort: Same 26 authored atomic claims; four-class JSON with rationale
records.valid_interpretation: Negative model result, no human-calibrated accuracy

records.title: Real-Qwen label-only prompt and token constraint experiment
records.cohort: Three independent arms x 26 fictional author-labeled claims; new bare-label contract
records.valid_interpretation: Token constraint ensures canonical labels but did not improve semantic classification; label-only differs from prior JSON+rationale contract

records.title: Local Gradio end-to-end app and one real Qwen smoke
records.cohort: Six PREWRITTEN fictional walkthrough scenarios plus one independent real-Qwen positive-control generation
records.valid_interpretation: UI assembly and real Qwen control-flow smoke verified, NOT live hosted deployment or semantic entailment
